contribution_requirements: Follow .kiro/steering/avionics-project.md (project memory; its 'Flight timeline requirement' section is the spec). Grok_*.py files are the hardware authority and win every conflict. Each modified .py keeps its 3-line header block (target board, interpreter, authority/dependency). Preserve function names, CLI flags, display modes, comment style, the fail-soft init design and the SIGTERM handler. Do not add features beyond the spec (no manual arm, no GPS-loss timeout, no RX-side clock). Tell the user explicitly that an RX redeploy is required (it is: YES).
key_patterns: TX_Telemetry.py is module-level flow (no main()): constants -> SIGTERM handler -> camera helpers -> GPS init/poll_gps() -> I2C init functions returning ok flags -> baro helpers -> LoRa init (sys.exit(1) on failure) -> loop with time.monotonic() deadline scheduler, per-sensor-group try/except, guarded lora.send, once-per-second status print, finally: camera stop. Packet = ASCII CSV; decoder splits exactly NUM_SENSOR_FIELDS fields and rejoins the rest as the GGA sentence (it contains commas). Empty string = sensor unavailable for float fields, 0 for ints. telemetry_decode.decode() returns a nested dict (raw, accel_g, gyro_dps, temp_c, heading_deg, baro{temp_c,press_hpa,alt_m,agl_m}, gps{...fix_quality,num_sats}); RX_Temenetry.py inlines decode + TelemetryDB + LiveState (thread-safe snapshot) + three displays (render_dashboard, run_terminal_dashboard, run_gui_dashboard, scroll prints in on_recv). telemetry_db.py: SCHEMA executescript + _ensure_columns() PRAGMA table_info/ALTER TABLE migration + _INSERT. playback.py reads rows via telemetry_db and prints per-row blocks.
directory_structure: Workspace root: Grok_*.py (bench authority, read-only), root-level prototype .py (read-only), 'System Scripts/' (the 11 deployable files; 7 change in this task), '3D Prints/', '.kiro/steering/avionics-project.md' (project memory), '.agents/tasks/' (plans, reviews, this task's artifacts under task-flight-timeline/), '.agents/backup/' (pristine copies, never edit).
